title: Kale, feta and white bean dip

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Kale, tinned beans, feta, yoghurt, garlic, lemon and raw vegetables are all plain home ingredients, with no jars or packet products.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including feta and tinned cannellini beans, is an everyday Tesco purchase at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a bowl and a masher, and the technique is simple wilting and mashing.

works.reason: A tin of beans with 150g kale, 100g feta and yoghurt makes a well-seasoned dip for four, and the 4 carrots, half a cauliflower and 2 apples give ample crudités.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers stripping and chopping the kale, mashing, zesting and cutting the crudités, and the 4-minute wilt matches the 5 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon zest and juice and the chilli flakes, is used, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Kale is in the title and gives the dip its body and colour, which suits a February afternoon with winter roots and apples alongside.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beans, greens, feta and fresh vegetables and fruit make a filling, wholesome snack a family would eat again.
